arguments.name: Animation Colour Script
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the light-script step: one hue pair per beat (D74), one emitter at a time, no hue detour across a crossing (C15 at episode scale, C30).
arguments.subject: animation-colour-script
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-colour.py --contract v3/light.json --timeline v3/timeline.json` in the renderer root and passes only when every check it prints passes; its first printed line is its positive control and it refuses to report if the control does not trip. Reads the light track contract before any render: pairs, emitter handoffs and crossing hue paths. On FAIL quote the probe's own line naming the frame or beat and fix the contract or the render, never the probe. Control: two emitters on one frame is refused.
